scope: Independent review of rendered report wording and retained source mappings. No reports were edited during this review.
critical_conclusion: No material wording errors or evidence-link mismatches require correction.

confirmed: Failed activity tests describe absent renewal without claiming observed session loss.
Security descriptions separate controlled observations from possible production consequences.
Partial and blocked results describe missing checks without claiming product failure.
The P1 hold remains separate from P2 applicability checks and P3/P4 follow-up.
Sampled combination descriptions disclose simulated replies, direct helper calls, and missing business-save checks.
The selected combination reply is described as undelivered when no renewal request existed.

findings.description: The earlier wording did not clearly place access expiry before sign-out.
findings.resolution: The revised text states that access had already expired when sign-out reported success.

findings.description: The earlier wording confused session renewal with obtaining a renewal credential.
findings.resolution: The revised text names the pending request for a renewal credential.

limitations: This review did not execute application tests or verify production exposure.
The review checked HTML content and structure. It did not replace browser visual verification.
Semantic review sampled 13 of 181 combination instances. Programmatic mapping checks covered all 285 adverse case descriptions.
Raw combination result statuses are historical. The current case-priority audit supplies the normalized report dispositions.
Automated checks do not check the complete approved dictionary or grammar rules.

final_confirmation.scope: Final presentation changes only: token explanation and expanded search text.
notes: The top conclusion defines the saved renewal token as a refresh credential.
The copied-token consequence remains conditional, with production exposure explicitly unverified.
The companion search includes all description fields for each of the 285 cases.
Initial reviewed-source hashes are preserved in the sources array.
